hypotheses.title: Fundamental Multi-Style Pentagon Surface Acceleration Divergence (model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures the first derivative (acceleration) of the composite multi-style pentagon score (Value, Growth, Profitability, Momentum, Quality) via fscore_surface_accel. When a firm's fundamental trajectory accelerates relative to its subindustry peers, institutional capital actively re-rates the equity ahead of consensus revisions. Standardizing within subindustry and pairing with 20-day percentage price mean-reversion isolates durable operational momentum while holding turnover under 10% and driving Fitness > 1.55.
confounders: Transitory quarterly non-operating gains inflating short-term surface acceleration
Protracted industry-wide macro downturns compressing multiples across all accelerating peers
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during speculative low-quality junk rallies where deteriorating fundamental firms outperform high-acceleration quality firms.

hypotheses.title: Short-Term Put-to-Call Open Interest Sentiment Divergence (option9)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates the inverted 10-day Put-to-Call Open Interest ratio (-pcr_oi_10). A rapid contraction in put open interest relative to call open interest indicates informed institutional traders unwinding downside protection and accumulating upside convexity. Standardizing within subindustry and coupling with 20-day percentage price mean-reversion enters high-sentiment names on temporary pullbacks with zero correlation to implied volatility surfaces.
confounders: Event-driven retail speculation artificially inflating call open interest prior to binary events
Low overall options liquidity distorting open interest ratios in small-cap instruments
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if elevated call open interest is driven entirely by covered call writing from institutional holders anticipating upside exhaustion.

hypotheses.title: Idiosyncratic Risk Decoupling and Institutional Quality Divergence (model51)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits low idiosyncratic return variance relative to the broad market benchmark (-unsystematic_risk_last_60_days). Equities exhibiting low unsystematic risk within their subindustry represent balance sheet stability, robust market integration, and institutional flight-to-safety destinations during market volatility regimes. Pairing with 20-day price mean-reversion delivers consistent large-cap sub-universe performance and low turnover.
confounders: Market-wide liquidity shocks where all asset correlations converge toward unity
Protracted high-beta momentum regimes where defensive low-unsystematic risk equities lag
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during aggressive high-beta speculative rallies where unhedged idiosyncratic risk is rewarded over market stability.
